question: Sattriya dance form is famous in which of these states?
solution:
The correct answer is __Assam.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sattriya** is a classical dance form originating in Assam.
 
• It was introduced in the 15th century by the great Assamese Vaishnav saint and reformer, **Srimanta Sankardeva**.
 
• This dance was initially performed in **Satras** or monasteries as a part of the daily rituals or to mark special festivals.
 
• **Sattriya** combines elements of dance, drama, and music to narrate mythological stories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Detail
 
 
 
 

 **Recognition**
 Sattriya was recognized as a classical dance form by the Sangeet Natak Akademi of India in 2000.
 
 

 **Elements**
 It incorporates elements such as **Nritta** (pure dance), **Nritya** (expressive dance), and **Natya** (dramatic storytelling).
 
 

 **Music and Instruments**
 The dance is performed with traditional Assamese music and instruments like **Khol** (drum), **Taal** (cymbals), **Flute**, and **Violin**.
